scripts.speaker: Guillaume Knight
scripts.text: The objective of the Flavius Battle is to score 2 points before your enemy by destroying their crystal.

scripts.speaker: Guillaume Knight
scripts.text: The crystals for both armies are protected by special barricades that cannot be destroyed by direct attacks.

scripts.speaker: Guillaume Knight
scripts.text: But they can be removed by destroying the Guardians that protect the enemy army base.

scripts.speaker: Guillaume Knight
scripts.text: The crystals are immune to every type of skill; your physical attacks are the only choice for destroying your enemy's crystal.

scripts.speaker: Guillaume Knight
scripts.text: If you are ready, start by clicking the ^0000FFbattle button from the interface^000000.

scripts.speaker: Guillaume Knight
scripts.text:
Please remember: when you join a battle, you will be receiving a token which indicates the set duration for which you cannot participate in the same type of battle.
You may check the duration by pressing the Alt+U keys.

scripts.speaker: Guillaume Knight
scripts.text: Please bear in mind once you cancel, ^0000FFyou may not reapply for 1 minute^000000!

scripts.speaker: Guillaume Knight
scripts.text: Are you ready for battle? Then apply with the recruiter next to me!
